items.exampleEn: The boys dived into the cold lake.
items.exampleZh: 男孩們跳進冰冷的湖裡。

items.exampleEn: Few players attain this level of skill.
items.exampleZh: 很少球員能達到這種技術水準。

items.exampleEn: You can renew your bus pass online.
items.exampleZh: 你可以上網續辦公車定期票。

items.exampleEn: The storm devastated the farmer's fruit trees.
items.exampleZh: 暴風雨摧毀了農夫的果樹。

items.exampleEn: They furnished the new office with modern desks.
items.exampleZh: 他們用新式的桌子布置新辦公室。

items.exampleEn: New workers need time to accustom themselves to the night hours.
items.exampleZh: 新員工需要時間讓自己習慣夜班的時間。

items.exampleEn: The teacher asked me to rewrite the last part.
items.exampleZh: 老師要我重寫最後一段。

items.sentenceEn: We had to rewrite the whole report after the meeting.
items.sentenceZh: 開完會後，我們得把整份報告重寫。

items.audioEn: My gym membership ends this month, so I will renew it on Saturday.
items.audioZh: 我的健身房會員這個月到期，所以我星期六會去續約。
items.questionZh: 說話者星期六要做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: The team was devastated when they lost the final game.
items.sentenceZh: 輸掉決賽時，整個隊伍極度難過。

items.sentenceEn: He is now accustomed to getting up at six.
items.sentenceZh: 他現在已經習慣六點起床了。

items.stemEn: Please ____ your coat; it's windy outside.
items.stemZh: 請把外套扣好，外面風很大。

items.stemEn: She practiced every day to ____ a high score on the test.
items.stemZh: 她每天練習，為了在考試中拿到高分。

items.passageEn: Last year, Ben moved from Taipei to a small town by the sea. At first, it was hard for him to accustom himself to the quiet life. He rented an old house and slowly furnished it with things from local shops. He also learned to dive, and now he dives near the town every weekend. Ben works from home as a writer. His first book did not sell well, and the news devastated him. But he rewrote it, and he hopes to attain his goal this time.
items.passageZh: 去年，Ben 從台北搬到海邊的一個小鎮。一開始，他很難讓自己習慣安靜的生活。他租了一間老房子，慢慢用當地商店買的東西布置。他也學會了潛水，現在每個週末都在鎮上附近潛水。Ben 在家當作家。他的第一本書賣得不好，這個消息讓他非常難過。不過他把書重寫了，希望這次能達成目標。

questions.questionZh: Ben 怎麼布置他租的房子？
options: 用當地買的東西慢慢布置
屋主早就已經都布置好了

questions.questionZh: Ben 的第一本書賣得不好之後，他做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 我花了一段時間才習慣這裡的天氣。
referenceEn: It took me some time to get accustomed to the weather here.
It took me a while to accustom myself to the weather here.
rubricZh: 可用 get accustomed to 或 accustom oneself to 等
to 是介系詞，後面接名詞或動名詞（例如 the weather、living here），不接原形動詞
「花了一段時間」可寫 It took me some time、It took me a while 等
寫成 get used to 意思也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 renew 造一個句子，說說你最近續過或即將更新的東西（例如證件、會員）。
referenceEn: I renewed my library card last week.
I am going to renew my driving license next month.
rubricZh: renew 表示「更新、續（期）」，後面接證件、會員或合約等
已發生的事用過去式（例如 renewed），未來可用 will、be going to 等
